digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each sit at the 800 LOC CI module-size cap, blocking further edits without architectural decomposition

completion.py carries four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug screen DET layer, verdict reconciliation) that should be separated into modules with clear contractual boundaries
completion_recovery.py carries three distinct concerns (criteria surface/bounds/coverage contract, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that should be split along existing seams

Behavior-preserving refactor moves symbols along call-graph clusters into new modules while maintaining stable public re-export facades so existing callers and test patch strings remain valid unchanged
All nine target modules (edited/created) must stay within 200–500 LOC bounds, with no file exceeding 800 LOC and make lint/typecheck passing zero-assertion-change tests
